10.es: ¿Van a mover a mi papá a terapia intensiva?
10.en: Are they going to move my dad to intensive care?

10.es: ¿Van a colgar mi ropa en el clóset de la habitación?
10.en: Are they going to hang my clothes in the closet in my room?

16.es: ¿Ustedes colgarían este cuadro en la entrada?
16.en: Would you guys hang this painting in the entryway?

19.en: Have you guys already turned off the heat?

1.en: Where do you guys throw away used batteries?

set.note: Regular -ar verb: *tiro, tiras, tira*; preterite *tiré, tiró*; subjunctive and *usted* command *tire*. It also means to knock over or spill: *tiré el café*.

10.es: ¿Van a agradecer a los bomberos de alguna manera?
10.en: Are you all going to thank the firefighters somehow?

14.es: Nunca le agradeceré lo suficiente su ayuda, doctora.
14.en: I'll never be able to thank you enough for your help, doctor.

20.es: Todavía no les hemos agradecido a los vecinos su ayuda.
20.en: We still haven't thanked the neighbors for their help.

14.es: Tranquilos, ustedes no conducirán; los llevará un chofer.
14.en: Don't worry, you guys won't drive; a driver will take you.

22.en: Had you all driven on that highway before?

10.es: ¿Van a prender el asador para la carne?
10.en: Are you guys going to fire up the grill for the meat?

10.es: ¿Van a empujar la puerta o esperamos a que abran?
10.en: Are you guys going to push the door, or should we wait for them to open it?

32.es: No empuje la puerta; se abre sola.
32.en: Don't push the door; it opens by itself.

7.es: ¿En su trabajo anterior ustedes traducían documentos médicos?
7.en: At your old job, did you all translate medical documents?

uses.en: to build … with one's own hands
uses.x: Mi abuelo construyó esta casa con sus propias manos.
uses.xen: My grandfather built this house with his own hands.
